components.name: Primary Action
components.description: 深色方正主按钮，承载合作表单提交。
components.css: .ds-primary { color: #fff; background: #070908; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: .8rem 1.5rem; min-height: 3.8rem; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC Variable', sans-serif; font-weight: 650; transition: color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-primary:hover { color: #070908; background: #52b8bc; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Text Link
components.description: 无填充下划线行动链接，配合箭头表达继续探索。
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2.2rem; min-height: 3.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #52b8bc; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link:hover span { transform: translate(.25rem, .25rem); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-link span { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: 作品归档的分类筛选状态。
components.css: .ds-chip { color: #55615c; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(7,9,8,.18); border-radius: 999px; padding: .55rem 1.15rem; min-height: 2.6rem; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-chip:hover { color: #fff; background: #070908; border-color: #070908; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Brief Field
components.description: 纸白背景中的底边线表单字段。
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .65rem; padding: 1.3rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(7,9,8,.18); } .ds-field span { color: #55615c; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-field input { color: #070908; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.8rem; padding: 0; font: 1.05rem 'Noto Sans SC Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Accordion Navigation
components.description: 1180px 以下使用可滚动的黑色全屏导航，业务栏目以一次展开一组的手风琴显示独立服务页链接。
components.html:
02数字空间
展厅展馆
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { overflow-y: auto; color: #fff; background: #070908; } .ds-mobile-nav > div { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-mobile-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mobile-nav span { color: #52b8bc; font: .58rem 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-submenu { padding-left: 1.6rem; color: #9ba9a2; } .ds-mobile-nav :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Strip
components.description: 全宽代表项目入口，画册案例图和元数据面并列，低强度折面响应不遮挡项目证据。
components.html: 智慧地信产业展厅SMART GEOSPATIAL EXHIBITION HALL
components.css: .ds-project-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(280px,.65fr); min-height: 350px; color: #070908; background: #fff; text-decoration: none; } .ds-art { background: #52b8bc; } .ds-art-image { background: linear-gradient(rgba(7,9,8,.08),rgba(7,9,8,.2)), url('/work/space-hanjie.jpg') center/cover; } .ds-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 2rem; background: #f4f3ee; } .ds-project-strip strong { font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-project-strip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6d5a; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: 晴蛙视觉把改变观看方式变成可移动、可折射、可拆解的视觉镜头。画册案例图提供项目证据，黑色观测场、纸白内容面、晴蛙青识别色与低强度折面覆盖构成全站共同语法。
keyCharacteristics: 中文显示与 Archivo 校准标签

rules.name: The Optical Rarity Rule
rules.body: 晴蛙青负责识别和行动，珊瑚与酸绿只在需要产生折射、频谱或概念区别时出现。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 页面分区保持平面与硬边，深度必须来自视觉机制，而不是装饰性卡片效果。

dos: Do 让首屏直接展示标志、主张和查看作品行动。
Do 让画册项目图成为主要证据，并将视觉探索清楚标记。
Do 在商业发布前复核公司概览、资质和联系渠道。
donts: Don't 把视觉探索写成真实客户项目或业绩证明。
Don't 为画册案例补写未经确认的成果、预算或客户评价。
Don't 引入通用营销英雄、卡片嵌卡片或 stock 风格摄影。
